verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ٱلسُّوسَنِّ». شَهَادَةٌ. لِآسَافَ. مَزْمُورٌ يَا رَاعِيَ إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱصْغَ، يَا قَائِدَ يُوسُفَ كَٱلضَّأْنِ، يَا جَالِسًا عَلَى ٱلْكَرُوبِيمِ أَشْرِقْ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim-eduth, A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest [between] the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

verses.ar: قُدَّامَ أَفْرَايِمَ وَبِنْيَامِينَ وَمَنَسَّى أَيْقِظْ جَبَرُوتَكَ، وَهَلُمَّ لِخَلَاصِنَا.
verses.kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come [and] save us.
verses.web: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ أَرْجِعْنَا، وَأَنِرْ بِوَجْهِكَ فَنَخْلُصَ.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، إِلَى مَتَى تُدَخِّنُ عَلَى صَلَاةِ شَعْبِكَ؟
verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.web: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

verses.ar: قَدْ أَطْعَمْتَهُمْ خُبْزَ ٱلدُّمُوعِ، وَسَقَيْتَهُمُ ٱلدُّمُوعَ بِٱلْكَيْلِ.
verses.kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

verses.ar: جَعَلْتَنَا نِزَاعًا عِنْدَ جِيرَانِنَا، وَأَعْدَاؤُنَا يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ بَيْنَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.web: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.ar: يَا إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ أَرْجِعْنَا، وَأَنِرْ بِوَجْهِكَ فَنَخْلُصَ.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.web: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

verses.ar: كَرْمَةً مِنْ مِصْرَ نَقَلْتَ. طَرَدْتَ أُمَمًا وَغَرَسْتَهَا.
verses.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

verses.ar: هَيَّأْتَ قُدَّامَهَا فَأَصَّلَتْ أُصُولَهَا فَمَلَأَتِ ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: Thou preparedst [room] before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.web: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

verses.ar: غَطَّى ٱلْجِبَالَ ظِلُّهَا، وَأَغْصَانُهَا أَرْزَ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof [were like] the goodly cedars.
verses.web: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

verses.ar: مَدَّتْ قُضْبَانَهَا إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَإِلَى ٱلنَّهْرِ فُرُوعَهَا.
verses.kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.web: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

verses.ar: فَلِمَاذَا هَدَمْتَ جُدْرَانَهَا فَيَقْطِفَهَا كُلُّ عَابِرِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ؟
verses.kjv: Why hast thou [then] broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

verses.ar: يُفْسِدُهَا ٱلْخِنْزِيرُ مِنَ ٱلْوَعْرِ، وَيَرْعَاهَا وَحْشُ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ.
verses.kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.web: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

verses.ar: يَا إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، ٱرْجِعَنَّ. ٱطَّلِعْ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَٱنْظُرْ وَتَعَهَّدْ هَذِهِ ٱلْكَرْمَةَ،
verses.kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

verses.ar: وَٱلْغَرْسَ ٱلَّذِي غَرَسَتْهُ يَمِينُكَ، وَٱلِٱبْنَ ٱلَّذِي ٱخْتَرْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch [that] thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.web: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

verses.ar: هِيَ مَحْرُوقَةٌ بِنَارٍ، مَقْطُوعَةٌ. مِنِ ٱنْتِهَارِ وَجْهِكَ يَبِيدُونَ.
verses.kjv: [It is] burned with fire, [it is] cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

verses.ar: لِتَكُنْ يَدُكَ عَلَى رَجُلِ يَمِينِكَ، وَعَلَى ٱبْنِ آدَمَ ٱلَّذِي ٱخْتَرْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ،
verses.kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man [whom] thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.web: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

verses.ar: فَلَا نَرْتَدَّ عَنْكَ. أَحْيِنَا فَنَدْعُوَ بِٱسْمِكَ.
verses.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، أَرْجِعْنَا. أَنِرْ بِوَجْهِكَ فَنَخْلُصَ.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.web: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
